title: Muxed-contract strkey for the all-zero contract id with muxed id 0
why: An all-zero payload is the degenerate W address; a reader that treats zero bytes as 'absent' or normalises the contract id drops or changes it.
notes: Built by xdrcheck-corpus synth from corpus/recipes/strkey/synthetic-gap-vectors.muxed-contract-zero.json. The text was encoded from the stated payload with an independent SEP-0023 encoder (version byte, payload, CRC16-XModem little-endian, RFC 4648 base32 without padding) and decoded back by the same rules; no SDK output was used. Not a probe vector; first executed by the conformance drivers. A W address exists only from Protocol 30 (CAP-0084): columns whose XDR schema predates Protocol 30 refuse it cleanly, which is not a divergence.
